newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ICI Australia appoints Weickhardt as m.d..
newsitem.headline: ICI Australia appoints Weickhardt as m.d..

text.p: ICI Australia Ltd said on Friday it had appointed executive director Philip Weickhardt managing director of the company with immediate effect.
Weickhardt, 48, replaced former managing director Warren Haynes, who died 10 days ago.
Weickhardt has spent all of his working life with ICI and is also a director of Incitec Ltd, which is controlled by ICI Australia, said ICI.
ICI Australia is 62.4 percent owned by Imperial Chemicals Industries Plc, which plans to sell its entire stake in the Australian group.
